value.rationale: The standard comb is a natural path-corona tree used explicitly in zero-forcing literature. The new statement upgrades a known scalar path-cover equality to a complete census of optimal placements. In odd order, distinct minimum path covers overlap on the same leaf sets, so the exact factor \((3m+4)2^{m-1}\) requires a genuine overlap analysis rather than a routine independent-choice product.
